title: Bee Removal in Norwood, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest treatment and removal in Norwood, Bronx. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Active wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Norwood home or building? The Best Pest Control NYC treats and removes stinging insect nests throughout this vibrant Bronx neighborhood — from wall voids and soffits to attics, eaves, and ground burrows. Our licensed technicians handle wasp and hornet nests in Norwood's mix of residential homes, pre-war apartment buildings, and commercial properties, plus carpenter bee infestations in structural wood and ground-nesting bee colonies in lawns and landscaping.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Norwood residents for years with fast, reliable bee removal services that prioritize both safety and humane relocation when possible. Our licensed professionals use proven techniques and offer transparent pricing from $350-$550, ensuring your property is bee-free without hidden fees.
localContext: Norwood's tree-lined streets, proximity to Woodlawn Cemetery, and mix of pre-war apartment buildings and single-family homes create ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets — especially during spring and summer months when colonies grow aggressive. Wall voids in older brick buildings along Bainbridge Avenue and Jerome Avenue, wooden soffits and fascia boards, attic vents, and landscaped areas near the neighborhood's parks provide the sheltered cavities and ground access these insects seek. Carpenter bees drill nesting galleries into porch columns, deck railings, and window trim throughout the area.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Norwood?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in Norwood?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service for most stinging insect nest removals in Norwood. Because wasp and hornet situations can escalate quickly — especially near entryways or high-traffic areas — we prioritize emergency calls and work around your schedule to resolve the issue promptly.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Norwood?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What areas of Norwood do you service for stinging insect removal?
faqs.answer: We service all of Norwood, including areas near Mosholu Parkway, Woodlawn Cemetery, Bainbridge Avenue, Jerome Avenue, and all surrounding residential and commercial streets. Our technicians are familiar with Norwood's diverse building types and handle nest removal from homes, apartments, businesses, and outdoor structures throughout the neighborhood.
